paragraphs: US President Donald Trump has announced that Washington reached a historic peace agreement with Iran, mediated by Pakistan and Qatar.
The deal includes an immediate and permanent end to military operations on all fronts, including Lebanon.

According to Trump, Iran committed not to develop nuclear weapons and agreed to reopen the Strait of Hormuz for global energy supplies. While the US might lift economic sanctions, Trump ruled out giving Tehran cash. Although a virtual signing was originally planned, it was delayed after Israel tried to disrupt the process. Pakistani Prime Minister announced that the official signing ceremony would now take place on Friday in Switzerland.

If signed, the memorandum of understanding will start a 60-day negotiation period to solve the hardest problems, such as Iran’s enriched uranium stockpiles and its civilian nuclear programme, despite deep mistrust between both sides.

paragraphs: The United States and Iran agreed on a new peace deal. Pakistan and Qatar helped both countries talk to each other.

According to US President Donald Trump, Iran promises not to make nuclear weapons. They will also reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a very important sea route for oil. In return, America may stop its economic sanctions against Iran. The deal also stops all military fighting, including in Lebanon.
At first, Trump wanted to sign the papers online immediately, but the plan changed.

The Pakistani Prime Minister said the official signing ceremony will happen on Friday in Switzerland. If they sign the deal, they will have 60 days to discuss bigger problems about Iran’s nuclear projects.

paragraphs: The US and Iran have a new peace deal. Leaders from Pakistan and Qatar help them make this deal.

The US President, Donald Trump, says that Iran will not make nuclear bombs. Iran will also open the Strait of Hormuz again. It is an important sea route for oil. This deal stops all fighting in the area.

Trump wanted to sign the papers online, but it does not happen. Now, the official ceremony will be on Friday in Switzerland. If they sign the papers, they will have 60 days to talk about bigger problems. Many people are happy about this peace.
